main.description: Includes pricing/payment terms and x402 endpoint for issuing a receipt against an accept.

cost.description: Numeric price (integer or float) per the chosen frequency.

prepay.description: Whether payment is required before compute starts.

url.description: Service DID reference (did:web:HOST#pdr_market) of the bidder's market service. The requester calls com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.submitAccept via PDS service-proxying using this value as the atproto-proxy target, to settle the contract and obtain a receipt.
